title: Rep keeps pitching after the opt-out
scenario: Frank, a homeowner who's been getting lots of lender calls, tells the rep to stop calling. The rep ignores it and keeps pitching a cash-out refinance.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey, is this Frank? It's Tony from Copperleaf Home Loans, how you doing today?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Tony, Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd looked into a cash-out refinance on your home.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, like six months ago. I've gotten about forty calls since then.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, I bet. Well, I promise I'm the good one.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Fair. So are you still thinking about pulling some equity out? A lot of folks are using it for home projects or paying down cards.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: No. Look, I'm done with this. Stop calling me. Take my number off your list.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally hear you, but before I go, with the equity you've probably got, you could pull out a good chunk and pay off everything in one shot. It'll only take five minutes to see.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Did you hear what I just said?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I did, I did. I just don't want you to miss out.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'm not missing anything. I asked you to stop calling.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, okay. I'll take you off the list.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sorry about that, Frank. Take care.
